revisions.description: Added coverage for IEEE Std 802.3cs-2022 (Super-PON 10GBASE-SP1 and 10/2.5GBASE-SP1 PHYs), IEEE Std 802.3db-2022 (100GBASE-SR1, 100GBASE-VR1, 200GBASE-SR2, 200GBASE-VR2, 400GBASE-SR4, and 400GBASE-VR4 PHYs), IEEE Std 802.3ck-2022 (100GBASE-CR1/KR1, 200GBASE-CR2/KR2, and 400GBASE-CR4/KR4 PHYs and associated Auto-Negotiation capabilities), IEEE Std 802.3da-2026 (10BASE-T1M PHY), IEEE Std 802.3dk-2026 (100GBASE-BR10, 100GBASE-BR20, and 100GBASE-BR40 PHYs), and IEEE Std 802.3dg-2026 (100BASE-T1L PHY and associated Auto-Negotiation capability).
Added support for IEEE Std 802.3df-2024 (400GBASE-DR4-2, 800GBASE-CR8, 800GBASE-DR8, 800GBASE-DR8-2, 800GBASE-KR8, 800GBASE-R, 800GBASE-SR8, and 800GBASE-VR8PHYs).
Added support for IEEE Std 802.3cy-2023 (25GBASE-T1 PHYs).
Added coverage for IEEE Std 802.3cz-2023 (entries for 2.5GBASE-AU, 5GBASE-AU, 10GBASE-AU, 25GBASE-AU, and 50GBASE-AU).
Added MAU types specified in the IEEE Std 802.3cm-2020, IEEE Std 802.3ch-2020, IEEE Std 802.3ca-2020, IEEE Std 802.3ct-2021, IEEE Std 802.3cp-2021, and aligned with IEEE Std 802.3-2022.
Added MAU types specified in IEEE Std 802.3cu-2021

Added MAU types and associated AutoNeg capability bits specified in the IEEE Std 802.3-2018, as well as IEEE Std 802.3cb-2018, IEEE Std 802.3bt-2018, IEEE Std 802.3cd-2018, IEEE Std 802.3cn-2019, and IEEE Std 802.3cg-2019
Added support for 2.5GBase-T and 5GBase-T media types.

Added new MAU types and associated AutoNeg capability bits specified in the IEEE 802.3 amendments IEEE Std 802.3bk-2013, IEEE Std 802.3bj-2014 and IEEE Std 802.3bm-2015, which are now published in IEEE Std 802.3-2015, as well as IEEE Std 802.3bw-2015, IEEE Std 802.3by-2016, IEEE Std 802.3bq-2016 and IEEE Std 802.3bp-2016.
Added MAU types and associated AutoNeg capability bits specified in amendments to IEEE Std 802.3-2008: IEEE Std 802.3ba-2010 and IEEE Std 802.3bg-2011.
Added assignments that will be included in Clause 14 of IEEE P802.3.1.
Initial version of this MIB as published in RFC 4836.
